title: Round44 all-cardinal whole-body animation correction study
summary: Read21 primary educator/creator/tool sources and audited local assets. Research covers S N W E anatomy, whole-body phases, armor ownership, occlusion, pixel clusters, rig limits, floor contacts, JRPG cadence, action families and later character transfer.
